detailed_descriptions.en: Transform any urban space into an exhilarating aerial playground with this cutting-edge simulator dedicated to the micro drone class. Liftoff®: Micro Drones , the latest in the Liftoff® Drone Simulations series, is a love letter to the FPV community. This instalment builds upon previous successes, introducing enhanced graphics, a refined user interface, a dedicated drone and track editor, and an array of single and multiplayer game modes. Get ready for a next-level micro drone FPV experience!
